data.name: Lightning Arc
data.description: When you expend your psionic focus to penalize an enemy via the Lightning Blade blade skill, if the penalized target is adjacent to you at the end of its next turn, it is dazzled for one round and another enemy within %1 feet of the target takes %2d%3 electricity damage (Ref %4 halves).|LightningArcRange|LightningArcDamageDice|LightningArcDamageDieType|LightningArcDC
